reviewedState: Uncommitted implementation and documentation based on planning commit 7ad2eb0; final evaluation, fresh-agent exit evidence and hosted CI were not yet available.
observations: Scheduled maintenance no longer discovers or dispatches preparation or assessment. Its guarded watchdog closes stale owned browser sessions; it does not launch a browser or model call.

Hourly guarded cleanup calls the existing bounded expiry-only checkpoint and job deletion, with a 500 D1 write reservation covering the stated deletion bounds and ledger overhead. Unexpired rows remain eligible for retention.

The native public Worker requires browser continuation, which excludes the legacy GET poll-claim path. Explicit submission retains the existing bounded private continuation; uncertain provider usage hold handling is unchanged.
Documentation states the effects of interrupted and eight-hop-limited chains, pending or cached submissions, delayed cleanup on denied admission, and unchanged operating ceilings.
limitations: Offline source review and fixture tests only; no live inference, browser action, deployment or account billing verification was performed.
Final source-bound evaluation, genuine fresh-agent continuation, committed implementation and hosted CI remain to be verified separately before rollout.
The plan was committed separately before the reviewed worktree implementation. This review does not establish unobserved history or validate the subsequent merge and deployment.
